headline: A Times writer says they went up against an AI-generated employee from Synthesia and failed.
score_reason: Lowered from 2: only the headline and standfirst could be read.
importance_line: It is one writer's test of an AI role-play tool for practising difficult conversations at work, which matters to managers and staff who may train with such tools, though the details of the test are not known.
summary: The Times reports, in a first-person piece, that its writer took on an AI-generated employee from the British AI company Synthesia and failed; the paper describes Synthesia's recently released Sessions product as letting clients practise challenging conversations with staff.
